name: codec-armv7-causes
reason: Causes of the 32-bit ARMv7 codec timing failures at 4cbd1e86, one c6g.4xlarge host (Graviton2) from the gate image, kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws: the 13 workloads above the ceiling timed on CPU 1 with the gate build and with an A32-with-NEON build of codec-worker (armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf, -C target-feature=+neon) against the same reference, with both ledgers; perf stat user-mode cycles, instructions and branch misses of both builds and the reference on one workload per decoder, and perf records of the gate build with their symbol reports; the workers' SHA-256; for the ARMv7 open workloads of harness/codecs/workloads.json and file-workloads.json
